trigger.event: The first committed official build stopped fail-closed after 560 accounted rows because a negative sample had no finite six-MA segment.
trigger.diagnostic_scope: All 36,812 frozen manifest identities, using only each source prefix before 2026-05-04.

decision_before_rerun.negative_visual_review_selection: Choose the preregistered 12 density quantiles per kind from valid negative metrics only.
